acceptanceCriteria: CCF-V1-002 in docs/specs/core-compatibility-freeze-v1.md names cem/1.0 (or cites decision 0525 for the change) and matches cmd/corvint/core_freeze_test.go
REQUIREMENTS.tsv/INDEX.json regenerated and the spec doc gates pass
body: Observed 2026-10-14 in the V1-0285 closeout lane (PR beamfall/corvint#901, branch claude/v1-0285-closeout-evidence, BASE 495eda08c). docs/specs/core-compatibility-freeze-v1.md CCF-V1-002 states the frozen verification.spec value as cem/0.2, but cmd/corvint/core_freeze_test.go pins cem/1.0 after the RC3 CEM 1.0-only cutover (decision 0525, V1-1278). Expected: the spec row names the value the test enforces. Actual: stale cem/0.2 text. Confirmed by reading both files at BASE.
title: core-compatibility-freeze-v1: CCF-V1-002 row still names verification.spec cem/0.2 while the freeze test pins cem/1.0
